contacts.institution_name: JAM MUSIC LAB Private University for Jazz and Popular Music Vienna

country.evidence_quote: JAM MUSIC LAB is the first music university that is holistically specialised in jazz and popular music. We are seeking to extend the great tradition of classical music education in Austria by means of contemporary styles in jazz, pop and rock. An innovative setup of curricula interactively combines teaching, professional practice and research, and furthermore focuses on the requirements of the current music market. The university offers a practically orientated music education for future musicia
